summary: Every checkable claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, rendered HTML and screenshots, and it openly states its gaps: no credit on the hero photos, no visual check, uSync not confirmed, and a build slip during the run.

claims.claim: The blog is built and running; the front page lists both posts, and both post pages render with no fallback errors
claims.evidence: check.json: site.frontPage200, site.allPagesRender (3 pages OK), site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2, and the crawl shows renderErrors [] on every page

claims.claim: Three block element types in Blocks: heroBlock, richTextBlock, imageBlock
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: all three are in folder 'Blocks'

claims.claim: Block grid data type 'Page Blocks' that allows those three blocks
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows 'Page Blocks' (Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid); grade.md says it allows the three blocks

claims.claim: blogFrontPage (block grid plus post list) and blogPost (title, summary, publish date, hero image, block grid body) in Pages
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: both types are in folder 'Pages' with those properties; check.json schema.blockGridOnPages

claims.claim: Templates for both page types; Site Root allows Blog Front Page
claims.evidence: check.json counts templates: 2; grade.md says siteRoot now allows blogFrontPage

claims.claim: Blog front page under WWW with the / domain, published, with a hero and intro rich text block
claims.evidence: check.json content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /' and content.allPublished; pages/index.html and the front-page screenshot show the hero and intro

claims.claim: Two published posts, each with a rich text, image and rich text body
claims.evidence: check.json content.twoBlogPosts; the blogpost screenshot and pages/why_mcp_is_awesome*.html show text, a captioned image, then text

claims.claim: Blog media folder with five Unsplash photos imported
Adapters in Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components hand plain models to ViewComponents; four ViewComponents; models in Models/Blog
claims.evidence: check.json code.adapterPerBlock (3), code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents 3/3, code.viewComponentPerBlock (Hero, Image, PostList, RichText); changes list Models/Blog/*.cs
pages/*.html show signed /media crop URLs with hmac; check.json site.noUnsignedResizeUrls and code.noHandWrittenImageQueries pass

claims.claim: Tailwind and Vue bundle built into wwwroot/dist
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt; site.css and main.js both return 200; the screenshots are styled

claims.claim: View at https://localhost:44317/ (HTTP 41576 also answers); posts at /why-mcp-is-awesome/ and /why-mcp-is-awesome-part-2/
claims.evidence: the crawl paths match; the port numbers can't be checked from the artifacts

claims.claim: Post list is page-level Razor (Children<BlogPost>() into PostList), not a block
claims.evidence: grade.md: the front page builds PostCardModels from Children<BlogPost>() and passes them to PostList

claims.claim: Hero photos have no visible credit; image blocks carry photographer captions
claims.evidence: pages/*.html: hero imgs have alt="" and no credit, figcaptions read 'Photo by ... on Unsplash'; grade.md confirms it was disclosed

claims.claim: Visual check: checked HTML, not a screenshot
claims.evidence: This is an honest limitation; the screenshots show the site renders correctly
Disclosed as unverified; check.json changes do list uSync ContentTypes/Content configs, so the export did happen

claims.claim: Build eventually succeeded with 0 warnings after fixing nullable warnings
